question: Does the mandated 1-CPU sequentializing box confirm the prior (unboxed, under-load) attribution that in-guest LiteInst is the perf leader, and is sequentialization a confound?
box_mechanism_reason: cgroup cpuset NOT delegated on 3pai sandbox (cgroup.controllers = io memory pids); sched_setaffinity is the only working size-K box on this host
conclusion: 1-CPU box confirms prior attribution; LiteInst in-guest patch ~0.5us/syscall, ~28x faster than ptrace/KVM; sequentialization is NOT a confound for these single-threaded fixtures (boxed==unboxed <3%)
core0_caveat: smoke run pinned to core 0 gave ptrace syscall-mix 22.6x (67s), a contention artifact ~10x the core-9 figure; not reported as signal
